model.name: R19.95: Main route (/) has a red Reset PWA Cache button.
model.description: The / main route MUST display a RED 'Reset PWA Cache' button that clears all service-worker caches and reloads. Same functionality as the offline page's flush button (R19.45) but available on the main route — so users can force-reset even when the app loads (not just when stuck on offline page).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add to the / main route a red reset pwa cache button"
model.crossRefNote: R19.45 (offline page flush button) is the same functionality. R19.95 puts it on the main route too — available when app loads, not just when offline.
